name: Direction des Services de la Navigation Aérienne (DSNA)
notes: The official DSNA portal dsna.fr describes itself as 'DGAC/DSNA French Air Navigation Service Provider' (copyright DSNA); DSNA is a directorate of the DGAC under the French ministry, so it has no separate corporate identity beyond the DGAC/DSNA mark. The only logo found is the DGAC/DSNA mark (dgac wordmark over a DSNA tag) served as the portal's header image (tier 2, website-served). The older dsna.aviation-civile.gouv.fr host did not respond to this tool, and the ministry site ecologie.gouv.fr was not found to carry a DSNA page or brand kit. No logo terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.
